svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027 ◆ Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots ◆ Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar ◆ Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder ◆ OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough? ◆ US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers ◆
